Name: Xtardew Mobile Haley Polaroid
Author: hixega
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LcLZdHk.png[/img]

This mod adds the Haley polaroid from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley[/url] to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] as a background.

The polaroid image comes from the Xtardew Valley mod, and is not owned by me whatsoever. I will happily give up this mod if need be :)
[b][size=4]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gt2ud1F.png[/img]
[/size][/b]
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Run the game using SMAPI, and enjoy!

[size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/GdDiDTy.png[/img]
[/b][/size]
Want to chat? You can find me in the [url=http://discord.gg/3Z7A5xHWTn]StarLewd Valley[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/cAPJ5MevF5]Xtardew Valley[/url]﻿ discord servers :D

Please consider supporting me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/hixega]Patreon[/url] <3

[b][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/dASQmId.png[/img]
[/size][/b]
Please report bugs and suggestions here on the Nexus page, I'll work on them when I can ^^
